title: Syrian Tagine Jelly
description: A sweet and tangy jelly made with the flavors of Syria, perfect as a dessert or snack.
instructions: Combine the tomatoes, jelly, sumac, and tagine spice mix in a large saucepan.
Add the water and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the jelly has thickened.
Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature.
Strain the mixture through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean saucepan and discard the solids.
Bring the mixture to a boil over high heat and cook for an additional 5-10 minutes, or until the jelly has thickened to your liking.
Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature before serving.
